name: Equatorial Guinean law: the Ley Fundamental, the Spanish Código Civil as in force at independence, laws, decree-laws, decrees, orders, resolutions and treaties from the Boletín Oficial del Estado (official PDFs, and FAOLEX copies where the BOE has no usable text), and the OHADA Uniform Acts
label: Equatorial Guinea
record_note: Each act's own PDF text layer (no OCR of ours; scanner layers say Text-source: publisher OCR). Each act is filed as enacted on the day its own entry-into-force clause gives, counted from the date of the act where the BOE publication day is unknown (In-force-basis says which). Amending acts are their own folders and are not applied. Scans without a text layer, including the Código Penal 2022, are held. Complete national coverage is not asserted.
